title: Great experience!
text: Great communication. Driver was on time and met me at the airport.
author: sbrochen

title: Good ride, but late
text: Driver not at the welcoming sight but showed up a few minutes later. We expected him to be waiting for us, but a woman showed up and told us to wait in a certain area while she got the driver. The car was comfortable and clean, but we were not offered any bottled water as promised by Viator. Driver was competent but not communicative.
author: Patricia_W
